podcast.title: New Metal Offshoot
podcast.body: Crazy Town was described as a group that, while not purely new metal, incorporated some of the sonic characteristics and trappings of the genre, suggesting a broader influence of new metal sounds. "The Offshoots, groups that weren't pure new metal, but had some of the sonic trappings. Crazy town..."

podcast.title: Ozzfest Ejection (Reason for)
podcast.body: The band was reportedly kicked off the Ozzfest tour due to frontman Shifty Shellshock's excessive drinking. "Things got so bad at one point that he managed to get his band kicked off the Oz Fest tour for being too much of a drunk."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Rust Kicked Out for Being "Too Crazy"
podcast.body: According to his official record company biography, Charles Lopez, known as Rust, was kicked out of Crazy Town because he was deemed "too crazy." "if you believe his official record company biography, Rust was kicked out of the group for being too crazy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Tour Van Collision with Moose
podcast.body: The rap-rock group Crazy Town narrowly avoided serious injury when their tour van collided with a moose near Sudbury on Halloween night. The impact totaled the van and killed the moose, with neither surviving. "The van was totaled, so was the moose. Neither survived."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: 60 Mind Blowing Facts in 60 Minutes: The 5th Edition

xref.title: Emerging New Metal Offshoot
xref.body: Linkin Park was introduced as a "new band out of LA" that, while not purely new metal, exhibited some of the genre's sonic trappings, suggesting their emergence as part of the broader new metal wave. "Crazy town, popper roach, disturbed, and this new band out of LA called Lincoln Park."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: New Metal Offshoot
xref.body: Papa Roach was listed among "offshoot" groups that integrated some of the sonic elements of new metal into their music, even if they weren't considered pure new metal bands themselves. "Crazy town, popper roach, disturbed, and this new band out of LA called Lincoln Park."

xref.title: New Metal Offshoot
xref.body: Disturbed was mentioned as a band that, though not strictly pure new metal, shared some of the sonic characteristics and stylistic traits of the genre during its peak popularity. "Crazy town, popper roach, disturbed, and this new band out of LA called Lincoln Park."
